scope: BOOK 6 OFFLINE KERNEL ONLY — no live acquisition, no RPC, no database, no Book 7/8/D8

reproduced_defects.title: CONDITIONAL COMPARISON METHODOLOGY SPOOF
reproduced_defects.root_cause: authorize_comparison checked only 'if not methodology_ref', so any non-empty string licensed the comparison
reproduced_defects.reproducer: FC-05 protocol.volume.DEX_NATIVE vs protocol.volume.AGGREGATOR_ROUTED with methodology_ref='fake:anything'
reproduced_defects.repair: corpus row required_methodology is now a versioned identity (ref@version) matched EXACTLY, and the methodology must be registered, current, and declare authority for that corpus row

reproduced_defects.title: VALUATION PRICE SOURCE IS NOT BOOK-2-BACKED
reproduced_defects.root_cause: PriceObservation carried source_ref as a bare string with no Book 2 provenance; the engine checked only that it was non-empty
reproduced_defects.reproducer: source_ref='fake:oracle' with no cited claim authorized a PROTOCOL_COLLATERAL_MARK
reproduced_defects.repair: PriceObservation.source_claim_refs is REQUIRED and resolved through Book6Provenance at valuation authority time; a source_ref string is an attribution, never evidence

reproduced_defects.title: STALE CURRENT PRICE CAN PASS authorize_valuation()
reproduced_defects.root_cause: ValuationObservation.is_stale existed but authorize_valuation never consulted it
reproduced_defects.reproducer: price observed 30 days ago with staleness_bound_seconds=3600, as_of today
reproduced_defects.repair: authority split into authorize_current_valuation(as_of) and validate_historical_valuation(); as_of is always explicit, never a hidden wall clock

reproduced_defects.title: FAKE COVERAGE-SUFFICIENCY REF CAN CREATE DATA_COMPLETE
reproduced_defects.root_cause: data_status derived sufficiency from bool(coverage_sufficiency_rule_refs) without checking that any rule existed
reproduced_defects.reproducer: coverage_sufficiency_rule_refs=('fake:rule',) on a fully observed vector with coverage ids
reproduced_defects.repair: CoverageRuleRegistry plus a registry-issued CoverageSufficiencyAttestation; Book6MeasurementEngine.data_status is the live authority

reproduced_defects.title: METHODOLOGY REGISTRY REQUIRED BY THE AUTHORIZED DESIGN IS ABSENT
reproduced_defects.root_cause: the five separated stores were implemented as four; every methodology reference in the kernel was a bare string
reproduced_defects.reproducer: registry surface contained no methodology store at all
reproduced_defects.after_r1: Book6MethodologyRegistry present and consulted by every authority-bearing surface
reproduced_defects.repair: added book6_methodology.py with versioned ref@version identity, supersession and local invalidation

reproduced_defects.title: NORMALIZED VALUE ACCEPTED WITHOUT VERIFIED DERIVATION
reproduced_defects.root_cause: engine.normalize authorized whatever value the caller supplied on NormalizedMeasurement, ignoring rule.transformation and the declared inputs
reproduced_defects.reproducer: native value 10, PER_TIME denominator 2 (expected 5), supplied normalized value 999
reproduced_defects.repair: compute_normalized_value recomputes deterministically from declared inputs; the engine compares and refuses any disagreement

reproduced_defects.title: RULE STATUS FORGERY VIA model_copy / CONSTRUCTION
reproduced_defects.root_cause: StateRuleRegistry.authorize read rule.is_ratified() off the stored object, and CoverageSufficiencyRule.status was a bare str settable at construction
reproduced_defects.repair: ratification authority moved into a registry-owned RatificationLedger shared by both rule registries; rule objects may only be constructed and registered UNRATIFIED
